newsitem.title: USA: Mercury Radio sells 4 stations for $62 mln.
newsitem.headline: Mercury Radio sells 4 stations for $62 mln.

text.p: Mercury Radio Communications LP sold four radio stations in Buffalo, N.Y. to Broadcasting Partners Buffalo LLC for $62 million, Broadcast Partners said on Wednesday.
The stations include WEDG-FM, with an alternative rock format; WHTT-FM, an oldies station; WHTT-AM, ethnic and religious programming; and WGRF-FM, classic rock.
Broadcast Partners was formed by Broadcasting Partners Holdings LP and VS&A Communications Partners II LP. VS&A is affiliated with Veronis, Suhler & Associates.
